title: Thermal Proteome Profiling (TPP)
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs a custom Thermal Proteome Profiling (TPP) protocol using the Opentrons Thermocycler and Temperature Modules. The user is prompted as necessary to replace plates, reagents, and tips as needed throughout the protocol.
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download your protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and select your labware files (.json extensions), if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App's Protocol tab, upload your protocol file (.py extension).

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App; see support articles for calibration tips.
